name: Nasdaq-100 risk-appetite regime + RSI dip — tech-beta dip buy (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why the Nasdaq leads crypto dips): the Nasdaq-100 carries the high-beta tech/liquidity factor that crypto co-moves with most strongly — a faster risk-appetite read than the broad SPX. When the NDX is holding an up-regime (above a fitted line), the liquidity/tech-risk backdrop is intact, so a crypto RSI dip is a buyable shakeout, not a regime break. The NDX leads because the tech-liquidity factor re-prices in equities before crypto follows. We require ndx_index above a fitted floor AND an RSI dip, exiting on RSI reverting up. Distinct from the nasdaq-leadlag-MOMENTUM spec: this is a DIP-BUY under an NDX regime. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain RSI-dip buy matches the deflated Sharpe, the NDX gate adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2 (non-stationarity): the raw NDX level trends up, so a fitted floor risks always-true — the Gate must reject a degenerate level; the edge must be the risk-appetite partition, not the index's drift. tier0 macro; low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: ndx_index is above a fitted regime floor (tech/liquidity risk-appetite intact) while RSI has dipped.
